macosarm64.codecs: Third-party build of the same CEF tag with proprietary_codecs=true and ffmpeg_branding="Chrome" (H.264, AAC, HEVC via VideoToolbox); not an official CEF build and carries no codec patent licence. See CODECS.md.

macosarm64Official.codecs: Official CEF build: no proprietary codecs (no H.264, AAC or HEVC), so it carries no codec patent licence obligation. The embed kit's default; the macosarm64 codec build is an option (scripts/package-embed-kit-macos.py --cef codecs).
